key_findings: Oxaliplatin-treated rats show persistent small fiber loss and increased spinal dorsal horn TRPV1, CGRP and SP immunoreactivity after 6 weeks, consistent with chronic neuropathic pain.
Acute oxaliplatin nerve hyperexcitability resolves within a week and is distinct from chronic axonal damage.
